硬装施工概述
 
Construction Overview
■
   
概述：
现场硬装是品牌形象店装修的重要组成部分，它不仅影响到店铺的外观形象，还与店铺的使用功能和安全密切相关。因此，在进行硬装时，
需要认真规划、精心施工，确保装修质量和效果。
■
   
规范：
由于建筑内部装修设计所涉及的材料范围较广，有些不可能在范围中均被包括，所以在施工时除了必须符合建筑内部装修设计防火规范的有
关规定外，且应符合现行的有关国家设计标准和强制性规范的要求。
■
   
选材：
基于品牌终端形象的完全统一，在店面装修前期，必须完全了解品牌要求的所有材料，且严格按照要求执行。
■
  
Overview
：
Site decoration is an important part of brand image store decoration, which not only affects the appearance and image of the store, but is also closely related to the use of the store's function and safety. Therefore, when carrying out the decoration, it needs to be carefully planned and carefully constructed to ensure the quality and effect of the decoration.
■
   
Specification：
Due to the wide range of materials involved in the design of building interiors, some of which may not be included in the scope, the construction must comply with the relevant provisions of the fire code for the design of building interiors in addition to the current requirements of the relevant national design standards and mandatory codes.
■
   
Material Selection.：
Based on the complete unity of the brand terminal image, in the store decoration in the early stage, you must fully understand all the materials required by the brand, and strictly in accordance with the requirements of the implementation.
